# tritonctl image

Browse images

Alias: img

Subcommands: list, show

Usage: `tritonctl image [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>`

## tritonctl image list

List the images you can use. With a project: public images, your silo's, your tenant's, and the project's own; without one, public images only

Alias: ls

Usage: `tritonctl image list [OPTIONS]`

## tritonctl image show

Show one image

Usage: `tritonctl image show [OPTIONS] <ID>`

- `<ID>`: Image name, name@version, uuid, or prefix
